title: Upper density theorem: a measure finite on compact sets has zero n-density on a Borel set at H^n-almost every point outside it
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let μ be a measure on the Borel sets of ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ ℝ^P, and let A ⊆ ℝ^P be a Borel set. Then for μHE[n]-almost every x ∈ ℝ^P with x ∉ A, μ(A ∩ B_ρ(x))/(ω_nρ^n) → 0 as ρ ↓ 0. Here B_ρ(x) is the open ball, ω_n = unitBallVolume n is the Lebesgue measure of the unit ball of ℝ^n, ρ^n is entered via ENNReal.ofReal, and the quotient is computed in [0, ∞]. (In the parent's notation: D(μ⌞A, x) = 0 for H^n-a.e. x ∈ ℝ^P ∖ A; no restriction on n.)
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (A : Set (Euclid P)), MeasurableSet A → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μ K ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∉ A → Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ => μ (A ∩ ball x ρ) / (unitBallVolume n * ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 0)
